PAM only searches email from allow-listed Livin senders, then reads the amount, transaction time, direction and merchant label. Bodies, attachments and message ids are never stored.
Only aggregate monthly and per-category numbers are sent to the analysis provider. No email content, merchant name, private note or message id. Declining AI keeps the recap fully usable.
Sent for analysis: inflow and outflow totals, per-category totals, transaction counts and coverage status.
Stays on device: email bodies, subjects, senders, message ids, merchant names, private notes, tokens and card numbers.

How to create an App Password
1. Open your Google Account → Security. 2. Turn on 2-Step Verification (required). 3. Choose App passwords, create one for PAM, then paste its 16 characters here.

An App Password grants read and send access to your mailbox. PAM only opens INBOX read-only, never sends mail, and stores the password encrypted on this device. It is removed when you disconnect the inbox or sign out.
Email and App Password are both required.

A sanitized business merchant name (max 120 characters), direction, method and category codes are sent to Microsoft Azure (GlobalStandard) for a category suggestion. No amount, date, email body, note, message ID or personal data is sent. GlobalStandard may process outside Japan West; this is not a guarantee of Indonesia-only processing or zero retention. Declining does not block import or summaries.
Server mode: categories and transaction details are saved to the server. Internal transfer and refund links remain read-only.
The 0.60 review threshold covers parser/import confidence — it is not a model accuracy probability.
